semantic_versioning.title: Magnum W Controller has new version numbers

confirm.title: Install Magnum W Controller {version}
confirm.description:
Magnum W Controller now numbers its releases 1.0.0, 1.1.0 and so on, instead of after their date. HACS takes {version} for an older version than the one installed, so it does not offer it as an update.

Submit to download {version} with HACS, then restart Home Assistant. From then on HACS offers new releases as usual.

abort.install_failed: HACS could not download {version}. In HACS, open Magnum W Controller, choose Redownload and select {version}, then restart Home Assistant.
